packageRules.description: Disable nested Cargo manifests without matching root lockfile references.
Group Cargo-compatible updates by Cargo semver rules: 1.x+ minor/patch and 0.x patch, but not 0.0.x.

Group Cargo-breaking updates (majors, 0.x minors, 0.0.x patches) so coupled crates such as syn and prettyplease migrate together. Renovate prefixes major group slugs with 'major-', so this slug matches the major fallback below.

packageRules.description: Major-update fallback: also covers cases the pinned Cargo isBreaking check misses (e.g. 0.2.3 -> 1.2.4). Becomes 'major-rust-breaking' after Renovate's major prefix.
